listing.name: Far Cry Instincts: Evolution — fci-recomp (VinceIP)
listing.summary: Version 0.2.1 describes story and map-editor support, but a complete playthrough is unconfirmed. The project’s known defects remain. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own original Xbox Far Cry Instincts: Evolution ISO or extracted disc files, title ID 55530060, version 3.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the shared repository’s instructions for Instincts: Evolution. BuildGame.cmd prepares each title separately; use Evolution’s own files.

warnings: Version 0.2.1 describes story and map-editor support, but a complete playthrough is unconfirmed. The project’s known defects remain.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
